---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

career_hr_leaders <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast)) |>
  select(name, career_home_runs, first_year, last_year) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  mutate(steroid_era = first_year <= 2009 & last_year >= 1994)

career_hr_leaders |>
  ggplot(aes(x = career_home_runs, y = reorder(name, career_home_runs), fill = steroid_era)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(career_hr_leaders$name)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#CC4C02", "TRUE" = "#2B8CBE"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "No era overlap", "TRUE" = "Overlap with steroid era"),
    name = "Era overlap"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Career Home Run Leaders by Era Overlap",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

barry_bonds <- Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(yearID)

barry_bonds |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2B8CBE") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Sluggers

This page explores sluggers in Major League Baseball using Lahman batting data.
